conditions: Must be a folder (not a file or other item type).
Must be located in the folder named "Legal Archive" (either directly inside it, or somewhere within its subtree — see ambiguity).
The total size of the files it holds must exceed 800 MB.
Must have a shared link, and that shared link's access level must be set to "anyone with the link" (public), not restricted to company or invited collaborators.
Its modified date must fall after August 15, 2026.
Phrasing implies there is exactly one such folder satisfying all conditions ("the folder").
